title.en: What the net fixes of one's own class

statement.en: Where a class meets the path's regularity and holds one's effects, the net fixes the least such class, oneself with everything downstream, and every such class reaches what the one reaches; at an occurrence that acts, these classes are closed under meets, not joins.
statement.zh: 凡一类满足此路之理且持己之所缘，网即定其最细者，即己连同下游一切；凡此类皆所及即一之所及；于有所缘之事件，此诸类对交封闭，对并不封闭。

laws.en: At an occurrence that conditions something, a class meeting P2 (constancy up to the net's end at its class) and P4 (holding its effects) has its block closed under the net: whatever anything alike to it conditions is alike to it. Conversely, a closed block gives P4, and P2 wherever it is decided of each alike occurrence whether it conditions something.
laws.zh: 在有所缘之事件处，满足 P2（于其类之至网之终有常）与 P4（持其所缘）之类，其块对网封闭：凡与之同类者所缘，皆与之同类。反之，块封闭则得 P4，于每一同类者可判其是否有所缘处并得 P2。
declarations: Becoming.«本类常闭当且仅当类闭»

laws.en: At an occurrence that conditions something, the meet of two classes meeting P2 and P4 meets them, and so does the meet of any family of them with a member; the family is not closed under joins: two such classes can have a least common coarsening that holds an occurrence alike to the member and not its effect.
laws.zh: 在有所缘之事件处，满足 P2 与 P4 之二类之交亦满足之，其任一有成员之族之交亦然；此族对并不封闭：二此类之最小共同粗化可持一与员同类者而不持其所缘。

laws.en: The class holding an occurrence alike with everything downstream of it, and nothing else with anything, is defined from the net and the occurrence alone; wherever some class meets P2 and P4 at the occurrence it does too, or wherever it is decided of each occurrence downstream whether it conditions something, or wherever everything within the occurrence's closure has the occurrence within its own, as at an element returning along the net; every class meeting them contains it.
laws.zh: 持一事件与其下游一切同类、他者皆不相类之类，唯由网与此事件定义；凡有类于此事件满足 P2 与 P4，此类亦满足之，且凡满足之类皆含之；其下游每一者是否有所缘可判处，或其闭包内每一者之闭包皆含此事件处，此类即满足之。

laws.en: Under every class meeting P2 and P4 at an occurrence, its line reaches exactly what a line under the one reaches, under the least class with no premise; given P2, P4 is equivalent to that. With each center under a class of its own meeting P2 and P4, the per-center condition along the net is the condition at the one, and along a net with no cycle it holds only where every center is one and the same occurrence.
laws.zh: 凡于一事件满足 P2 与 P4 之类，其线所及恰为一之线所及，最细之类无须前提；有 P2 时，P4 等价于此。各中心皆在其自满足 P2 与 P4 之类下时，各中心之沿网之条件即一之条件；于无环之网，唯诸中心为同一事件时成立。

laws.en: The identity meets P2 at every occurrence, the least class that does, and fails P4 wherever the occurrence conditions something other than itself. P2 alone is not closed under meets, and where the occurrence conditions nothing the meet of two classes meeting P2 and P4 can fail P2.
laws.zh: 同一处处满足 P2，为满足之最细类，凡事件有异于自身之所缘处不满足 P4。单有 P2 对交不封闭；事件无所缘处，满足 P2 与 P4 之二类之交可不满足 P2。

hypotheses.en: No axiom and no premise beyond each law's own, for every carrier, relation and class: the meet law at an occurrence that conditions something; the converse of the closure form where it is decided of each alike occurrence whether it conditions something; the witnesses' nets supplied, with equality on their carriers.
hypotheses.zh: 不加公理，除各律所带者外不加前提，对一切载体、关系与类：交律于有所缘之事件；闭合之形之逆于每一同类者可判其是否有所缘处；见证之网为所给，设载体上之相等。

does_not_show.en: Which class is one's own, or that acting presupposes a class holding its effects: that is 07's crux, argued and not settled.
does_not_show.zh: 何类为己之类，或行动预设一持其所缘之类：此为 07 之关键，有论而未定。

does_not_show.en: That an actual self's class meets the path's regularity, or holds its effects.
does_not_show.zh: 实际之自之类满足此路之理，或持其所缘。

does_not_show.en: That the classes meeting the regularity alone have a least member other than the moment: the identity meets it everywhere, and that family is not closed under meets.
does_not_show.zh: 单满足此理之诸类有异于一刹那之最细者：同一处处满足之，且此族对交不封闭。

does_not_show.en: That the classes meeting both are closed under joins.
does_not_show.zh: 满足二者之诸类对并封闭。

does_not_show.en: That the meet law holds where the occurrence conditions nothing.
does_not_show.zh: 事件无所缘处交律成立。

does_not_show.en: Any order of courses: holding one's effects ranks nothing.
does_not_show.zh: 任何进程之序：持己之所缘不排任何序。

next_delta.en: The crux, now the whole of the de se question on the path: whether acting presupposes a class holding one's effects, put to philosophers; and, with centers read off a flow, the per-center condition restated on them.
next_delta.zh: 关键，今即此路上 de se 问题之全部：行动是否预设一持己之所缘之类，交哲学家；并以由流读出之中心，重述各中心之条件。

correspondence.en: Read de se: where one's own class meets the path's two conditions, the net fixes the least such class, oneself with everything one's acts condition at any remove (the widest self of 07's table, least only among classes granted to hold one's effects: the net does not make them one's own), and what every such class reaches, that same downstream; which of them is one's own it does not fix, and nothing the line reaches turns on it. So, granted the regularity, the de se question on the path has nothing left but whether one's class holds one's effects; at an occurrence that conditions something other than itself, the identity, a self of one moment, meets the regularity and not that. The reading is the AI's.
correspondence.zh: 以 de se 读之：己之类满足此路二条件处，网定其最细者，即己连同己之行为辗转所缘之一切，07 表中最宽之自，并定凡此类之所及，即同一下游；何者为己之类，网不定之，而线之所及不系于此。故许此理，此路上 de se 问题只余己之类是否持己之所缘；于有异于自身之所缘之事件处，同一，一刹那之自，满足此理而不满足彼。读法为 AI 之。

history.en: 9 November 2026, J1 (route (b)'s join, board rule 9): «及之首步» moved to the grammar beside «及»; «各本类常闭续无外则同一中心» went, since the one-center law holds with each center under any class of its own, asking none of its premises «类», P2 or P4 («各续无外则同一中心», GrammarScope), and «各后类续无外即一之续无外» states the least class's per-center form with no premise; «返则后类本类常闭» takes its hypothesis as ReturnsAlong. Statement and claim unchanged; the 07 sentence citing the corollary now cites the general law.
history.zh: 2026年11月9日，J1（路线 (b) 之合观，看板规则 9）：«及之首步» 移至文法，与 «及» 并列；«各本类常闭续无外则同一中心» 去之，因一中心律于各中心在其任一己类下皆成立，不须其前提 «类»、P2 或 P4（«各续无外则同一中心»，GrammarScope），而 «各后类续无外即一之续无外» 陈最细类之各中心形式，无须前提；«返则后类本类常闭» 之假设今写作 ReturnsAlong。陈述与所陈未变；07 引此推论之句今引通律。
